summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community focus on various enhancements and optimizations, including integration efforts with Spark, performance improvements for OSSFileIO, and proposals for fine-grained access policies. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about optimizing CI processes and clarifying specifications related to table properties and metadata.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes on variant support and DSv2 API upgrades
Proposal to refactor OSSFileIO for performance improvements
Discussion on fine-grained read restrictions in loadTable response
Optimizing CI runner times by adjusting JDK testing strategies
